item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Database Agent for Azure Database for PostgreSQL
item.description:
Public preview of Database Agent for Azure Database for PostgreSQL. The feature monitors database health proactively and helps detect, understand, and respond to performance and health issues faster.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Shard-level metrics in Azure Managed Redis
item.description:
Azure Managed Redis public preview now includes shard-level metrics. The new per-shard visibility helps assess workload distribution, detect hotspots, and troubleshoot performance issues.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure Monitor Health Models
item.description:
Azure Monitor Health Models is now generally available. The feature lets you define workload health as a first-class construct by aggregating metrics, logs, and dependency signals into a single model.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: github: Monitor GitHub Copilot activity through Microsoft Agent 365
item.description:
Enterprises can stream GitHub Copilot agent activity into Microsoft Agent 365. This exposes audit data from GitHub Copilot clients in Microsoft’s agent control plane.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: WAF Insights for Azure Application Gateway
item.description:
WAF Insights for Azure Application Gateway Web Application Firewall is now generally available. The feature adds built-in dashboards in the WAF policy that combine logs and metrics for investigation.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Metrics usage insights for Azure Monitor workspace
item.description:
Metrics usage insights for Azure Monitor workspace is now generally available. It provides visibility into workspace metrics usage, including utilization, unused metrics, usage trends, and changes driving usage.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: SQL Performance Monitoring for Azure SQL Database
item.description:
Microsoft has opened public preview of managed SQL performance monitoring for Azure SQL Database. It provides built-in monitoring so you do not need custom data collection scripts or manual correlation across separate tools.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Performance monitoring for Azure Arc–enabled SQL Server
item.description:
The public preview for performance monitoring of Azure Arc–enabled SQL Server adds more flexible ways to explore and visualize performance data. Users can query Microsoft-managed monitoring data directly through a telemetry endpoint.

  • Source: Azure Updates
